paragraphs: I'm applying for the Finance & Strategy Analyst role at Stripe in New York. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. Stripe's focus on measuring the return on every dollar of spend, headcount and non-headcount, is the part of finance I've enjoyed most.

At JPMorgan Asset Management I built models to evaluate $10M of marketing-channel budget, quantified ROI across scenarios, and benchmarked past allocations against peers to find 30% efficiency gains. At Lenovo I built forecasts and scenario analyses that improved capital efficiency by 15% and ran variance analyses on budget reallocation for cross-functional teams.
That maps to running the budget and forecast cycle, owning the models behind it, and giving business partners a straight answer on what their spend is returning. I'd welcome the chance to talk.
